pages.text: $(bold)Four sources, and no others. Shards cannot be mined, crafted or traded for.
pages.title: III. Gaining Shards
Tasks
pages.text: $(bold)One per node. Pays once, for good.$(br2)A task counts only once its node is reachable: the node before it owned, its ring unsealed. Earlier work does not count.

pages.title: Bounties
pages.text: $(bold)Three at a time, lasting a few days. The third is always a delivery.$(br2)$(li)Finish one and the next comes 3 minutes later, or at dawn if that is sooner.$(br)$(li)Hold right-click on one in the Tasks tab to give it up, once a day; a new one comes at once.$(br)$(li)They grow harder as you unlock nodes, and pay up to 4 shards; rare ones pay 5.

pages.title: Deliveries
pages.text: $(bold)Some bounties ask you to hand in crafted items: 32 Iron Ingots, 2 Bookshelves.$(br2)$(li)Carry them all, then press Deliver.$(br)$(li)Plain items only: not damaged, named or enchanted.$(br)$(li)The third bounty is always one. Delivered or expired, it waits for dawn; given up, a new one comes at once.

pages.title: Staying Alive
pages.text: $(bold)Every full day you live without dying pays 1 Focal Shard.$(br2)Dying starts the count again.

pages.title: Achievements
pages.text: $(bold)A few vanilla advancements pay once: first iron smelted, first iron pick, and others.$(br2)First come, first paid.

pages.title: Keeping Track
pages.text: $(bold)$(li)A small popup at the right edge as a task or bounty moves on.$(br)$(li)A banner and a chime when one is complete.$(br2)Turn any of these off at the bottom of the Tasks tab on the ring.
